messages:
maria: Dropped the PRD draft for the unified API spec (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank) here: https://redwood.example.com/prd/unified-api-spec. Can we do a quick triage on launch acceptance criteria and high-risk edge cases? Need prioritization for customer-driven asks (esp. deterministic rerank from Customer X). :eyes:
aj: Quick read — biggest technical risk is streaming + rerank interaction. If we stream before rerank completes we may show inconsistent ordering. Two options: block stream until top-k rerank done (adds latency) or stream with a "rerank_in_progress" flag and patch results later. Need cost/latency numbers to pick.
sara: For rerank acceptance criteria I'd propose: top-1 precision >= 0.85 on our rerank_eval_v2 (prodish queries), and rerank latency p90 < 120ms. I'll attach eval plan and baseline numbers to the PRD. Also we need the specific eval dataset: "rerank_eval_v2" (50k queries).
dave: SDK impact: we'll add a new optional param `rerank_options`. Keep backward compatibility. Proposed shape: `{"strategy": "top_k"|"score_threshold", "k": 10, "fallback": null}`. Ensure default behavior is no-op when omitted. We should bump API minor version and include examples in SDK changelog.
kai: Security note: embeddings + rerank evals may contain PII. Eval storage must be opt-in and encrypted (KMS). Default retention TTL should be <= 30d and documented. Also require customer consent for using their queries in offline evals.
nina: Product context: Customer X is pushing hard for deterministic rerank (stable ordering across calls) for invoiced analytics. They want it in ~6 weeks. If tech risk is low we should consider prioritizing.
aj: Deterministic rerank tradeoff: need consistent tie-breaking seed or deterministic scoring. Seed gives stability but could reduce perceived relevance in edge ties. Recommend an A/B to compare stability vs. relevance delta.
maria: Draft acceptance checklist in PRD (WIP): 1) API contract finalized and documented 2) SDK examples and migrations 3) Infra capacity validated for 2x expected p95 throughput 4) Correctness evals (precision/recall thresholds) 5) Security/retention sign-off 6) Rollout plan + canary/safe-fallback. Add anything missing. :thumbsup:
sara: Add edge-case: very long contexts (>8k tokens). Embedding + rerank path must handle truncation gracefully and expose a warning in response if truncation occurs. Add explicit tests in eval plan.
dave: Ops/infra ask: Need perf run for combined path (chat streaming + post-hoc rerank) and a migration plan so existing clients see no behavior change. Default when `rerank_options` omitted = no-op. Can we schedule load test?
ops-bot: perf-job scheduled: run/rerank-loadtest-1790127890 queued for 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC.
maria: Great — let's sync 11:00 today to finalize prioritization. I'll convert these into tickets. @aj @sara @dave please add short notes to the PRD section "engineering concerns" before EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
